reconciliationRule.equation: CustomerChargeAmount - DiscountAmount == CarrierPayableAmount + SellerShareAmount + MarketplaceShareAmount + ShippingTaxAmount
reconciliationRule.signConvention: components are amounts credited to that party; SellerShareAmount and MarketplaceShareAmount are SIGNED (negative = seller bears / marketplace subsidises); discount funder is stored, not inferred
reconciliationRule.enforcement: fail-closed on mismatch; never plugged by residual inference
reconciliationRule.orderRollup: aggregate customer shipping = sum of group net charges; never fee x group count and never double-added with the legacy scalar
reconciliationRule.quoteVsActual: shipping_fee_adjustments rows + linked entries; original allocation never overwritten
reconciliationRule.idempotency: one live allocation per group + unique idempotency keys prevent double pay/refund
